rows.docSource: functional-spec.md DB 데이터 사용 명세: profiles | id, email, status | read | '비밀번호 재설정 성공 후 사용자 상태 확인에 연결될 수 있다' | 권한 'public/auth flow; no user-owned row access unless session exists' | 불확실성 none (lines 39-40)
rows.liveDbObject: profiles.id, profiles.status (LIVE columns); profiles.email DOES NOT EXIST in LIVE profiles — email is owned by Supabase Auth (auth.users.email)
rows.rationale: functional-spec.md lists profiles read with intentionally tentative wording ('연결될 수 있다' = 'may be connected'), and the row's own 권한 note says 'no user-owned row access unless session exists' — X-06 is a pre-auth public route with no session, so this read does NOT occur on THIS screen. Therefore strong-inference, not confirmed, and not a hard requirement. Of the named fields: profiles.id (PK) and profiles.status (CHECK active/blocked/deleted) are real LIVE columns; profiles.email is NOT a LIVE profiles column (email belongs to Supabase Auth auth.users, never duplicated into public.profiles) — the doc names a field that maps to Auth, not to a public column. Existing columns satisfy any post-recovery status check (which actually belongs to the post-login flow, not X-06). No stable-query need on this screen. NOTE: description.md (PRIMARY) is silent on any profiles read here, so the higher-priority source confirms this is not a screen requirement of X-06.

rows.rationale: CONTRACT-NOT-LABEL + STABLE-QUERY analysis: although labelled '스키마 보강 필요', the 확정 계약 states no such structure exists and the 메모 makes it explicitly conditional/hypothetical ('보안 정책이 필요하면', '필요하면'). description.md (PRIMARY) treats resend limiting as a client cooldown (useEmailCooldown) and rate-limit as Supabase server-side enforcement — so X-06 has NO confirmed query/validation/render need for a persisted resend-counter or audit ledger. study_events exists but its event_type catalog is frozen separately and contains no auth/password-reset/resend event.
